ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a para-substituted benzene ring, with a phenolic hydroxyl HO connected on the left side; the right side of the benzene ring is connected to a central carbon. This central carbon is also connected to the upper-right oxygen and the lower-right oxygen, and is labeled with a C-H. The lower-right oxygen is further connected to the oxygen in an HO. There are also curved arrows and charge markings in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows and excluding bonds involving hydrogen. Reasoning: Count according to the structural connectivity: inside the benzene ring there are 6 C-C bonds. Between the left side of the benzene ring and the phenolic oxygen there is 1 C-O bond. Between the right side of the benzene ring and the central carbon there is 1 C-C bond. Between the central carbon and the upper oxygen there is 1 C-O bond. Between the central carbon and the lower oxygen there is 1 C-O bond. Between the lower oxygen and the oxygen in HO there is 1 O-O bond. Exclude the phenolic hydroxyl O-H, the central carbon C-H, and the O-H bond of HO. The total is 6 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 11.

method.method_draft: First describe the visible structure, then count by components. Count 6 C-C bonds around the benzene ring. Add the left ring-C–O phenolic bond. Add the bond from the ring to the right-side central carbon. Add the central carbon bond to the upper O and the central carbon bond to the lower O. Add the O-O bond from the lower O to the HO oxygen. Exclude the phenolic O-H, the central C-H, and the HO O-H bonds, and ignore all arrows. The sum is 6 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 11.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中显示一个对位取代的苯环，左侧连接一个酚羟基 HO；苯环右侧连接一个中心碳。该中心碳还与右上方的氧、右下方的氧相连，并且标有一个 C-H。右下方的氧再与一个 HO 中的氧相连。图中还有弯曲箭头和电荷标记，但题目要求忽略箭头，并排除涉及氢的键。
推理：按结构连接关系计数，苯环内部有 6 个 C-C 键。苯环左侧与酚氧之间有 1 个 C-O 键。苯环右侧与中心碳之间有 1 个 C-C 键。中心碳与上方氧之间有 1 个 C-O 键。中心碳与下方氧之间有 1 个 C-O 键。下方氧与 HO 中的氧之间有 1 个 O-O 键。排除酚羟基 O-H、中心碳 C-H、HO 的 O-H 键。总数为 6 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 11。

method.method_draft: First describe the visible heavy-atom graph, then compute by degrees. The four unsubstituted ring carbons each have heavy-atom degree 2; the left substituted ring carbon has degree 3 because it also bonds to phenolic O; the right substituted ring carbon has degree 3 because it bonds to the side-chain carbon; the side-chain central carbon has heavy-atom degree 3, bonded to the ring carbon, upper O, and lower O; the upper O has degree 1; the lower O has degree 2, bonded to central carbon and the HO oxygen; the terminal HO oxygen has degree 1; the phenolic O has degree 1. The heavy-atom degree sum is 22, so the number of non-H bonds is 22/2 = 11.
